messages:
Maria Gomez: Team — Emerald Systems case study: interview transcript and raw quotes uploaded: https://drive.redwood/emerald-case-2026. Need a 300-400 word micro-case, one homepage pull-quote, and a 30s webinar teaser. Legal signoff on quotes by EOD Thu please.

Sasha Patel: Pulled 3 candidate quotes into /assets. I like Quote A for the hero, Quote B for email. Will mock hero comps tomorrow. :art:

Kevin Liu: Heads up: transcript mentions a revenue number and a 'proprietary throughput pipeline'. Legal requires revenue redaction or explicit permission and flags IP phrasing. Mark those lines.

Maria Gomez: Sasha — can you tag the paragraphs with the revenue and IP claims? I'll ask Emerald for permission but want edits ready.

Sasha Patel: Marked lines 42-47 with [REDACT] and suggested alternate copy: 'optimized inference pipeline' and 'order-of-magnitude improvement'.

Marco Rivera: Do we have Emerald's SVG logo and a 1200x628 screenshot for the case hero? If not, request from customer.

Sasha Patel: Logo pack + raw screenshots are in the drive under /assets/logos and /assets/screenshots.

Jonah Park: Webinar plan: 30-min customer + 10-min demo. Also want registrants tagged campaign=emerald_case and demo requests routed to AE queue EMERALD_DEMOS via webhook.

Casey Nguyen: I'll add the webhook: POST /hooks/leads?campaign=emerald_case. SFDC mapping -> Lead.Owner = EMERALD_DEMOS. Pushed config to staging.

Kevin Liu: Legal edit: remove the precise revenue and change '100x' to 'order-of-magnitude improvement' unless they can substantiate. I'll add a signoff checkbox in the doc.

Maria Gomez: Emerald replied: they'll approve 'order-of-magnitude improvement' but not the revenue or 100x. They signed the redline. Kevin, final pass?

Kevin Liu: Reviewing now. If I don't flag issues in 2 hours, consider legal approved.

LaunchBot: Calendar invite: "Emerald Case: Publish + Webinar Promo" Thu 03/26 10:00-10:30 PT. Attendees: Maria, Sasha, Marco, Jonah, Casey, Kevin.

Sasha Patel: Draft timeline in doc: Thu legal signoff + creative final; Fri landing + email live; Tue webinar registration opens; Tue following week live webinar.

Marco Rivera: Will upload hero comps by Fri EOD. Need 24h for tweaks if legal requests changes.

Casey Nguyen: Routing validated in staging; sample payload posted to #eng-infra.

Jonah Park: I'll prepare social + email flows once legal clear. Goal: 200 signups, 30 demo requests.

Kevin Liu: Legal cleared and approved language. :white_check_mark:

Maria Gomez: Publishing now. Landing: https://redwood.com/customers/emerald-systems-case. Webinar: https://redwood.com/webinars/emerald-systems-2026. Promo email scheduled Fri 03/27 09:00 PT.

Sasha Patel: Queued social drafts and email variants. Monitoring traffic after publish. :rocket:

Marco Rivera: Final assets uploaded to /assets/final. Archiving working files.

Maria Gomez: Closing thread — reopen if anything comes up.
